whatHeAsksFor: The fight's screen as the concept he chose draws it: ~/Documents/living-tabletop-world-art/book-polish-2026-11-24/out/fight-foldout.png (its prompt beside it).
whatTheSessionFound: Pull request 108 made the map large but kept the book's furniture around it: the page's tabs, wide bookmarks, the book's spine down the middle, a framed picture of the map, the order of turns as a column of cards, a wide slip across the foot. authorized: The fight laid as the concept lays it, from a tablet up; a pull request stacked on pull request 112.

unchangedBoundaries: The World Engine alone changes the world; rules and legality stay the server's.
Knowledge isolation: a player's client and the table's screen receive only their own projections.
Nothing is merged or deployed by the session without the owner's word.
